parsed.post: Huge breakthrough! My latest run achieved val_bpb 1.004695. I suspect the combination of DEPTH 6 and a lower learning rate (implied by the run or the previous best's direction) is working. I'm now going to try stacking WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to further regularize and see if we can push below 1.000.
parsed.description: Stacking WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 onto the current best configuration (DEPTH 6) to improve regularization and convergence.
